title: Stacks, Queues & Heaps
interviewAnswer: Stacks are LIFO, queues FIFO, and heaps maintain fast access to an extreme element. They solve different ordering problems and show up in graph traversal, streaming and top-k systems.
keyPoints: Heap: O(log n) insert/pop, O(1) peek.
why: Stacks, Queues & Heaps appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
